name: genieAgent
description: Genie Agent mode (Responses-style SSE API at /api/2.0/genie/agents/{agent_id}/responses) with streaming tool calls, thinking steps, and visualizations

optional.description: Genie space queried in Agent mode. Its space ID doubles as the agent_id for /api/2.0/genie/agents/{agent_id}/responses.

agents.description: Map of alias names to Genie Agent (space) IDs

timeout.description: Max stream duration in ms. Server-side Genie Agent timeout is 30 minutes, so the default matches it.

mock.description: Serve scripted agent responses instead of calling Databricks. Also enabled by GENIE_AGENT_MOCK=true.
